$comment: Which Xray-core releases the schemas are held to: every release tag from `floor` up, stable and prerelease alike, plus `extra` (`tag@commit`: a tag deleted upstream, read from that commit). The same rule xray-wasm uses. `lines` is optional grouping only — the Xray Config UI Editor's names for runs of tags, each named by the tag it reads; nothing here is checked per line.
